# 2 Kings Chapter 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 243v–244v

---

**23:1** And-sent the-king and-they-gathered to-him all the-elders [ziqney] of-Yehudah and-Yerushalayim.

**23:2** And-went-up the-king to-the-house of-YHWH, and-all the-men of-Yehudah and-all the-inhabitants of-Yerushalayim with-him, and-the-priests and-the-prophets and-all the-people from-small to-great [le-min qaton ve-'ad gadol]. And-he-read in-their-ears all the-words of-the-book of-the-covenant [sefer ha-berit] which-was-found in-the-house of-YHWH.

**23:3** And-stood the-king upon the-pillar [ha-'ammud] and-cut [vayikhrot] the-covenant [ha-berit] before YHWH, to-walk after YHWH and-to-keep his-commandments [mitsvotayv] and-his-testimonies ['edotayv] and-his-statutes [chuqqotayv] with-all the-heart [be-khol lev] and-with-all the-soul [u-ve-khol nefesh], to-establish [le-haqim] the-words of-this covenant, the-ones-written in-this book. And-stood all the-people in-the-covenant [ba-berit].

**23:4** And-commanded the-king Chilqiyyahu the-great priest and-the-priests of-the-second-order [kohaney ha-mishneh] and-the-keepers of-the-threshold to-bring-out from-the-temple [heykhal] of-YHWH all the-vessels [ha-kelim] which-were-made for-the-Ba'al and-for-the-Asherah and-for-all the-host of-the-heavens. And-he-burned-them outside Yerushalayim in-the-fields of-the-Qidron [shadmot Qidron], and-he-carried their-ashes to-Beyt-El.

**23:5** And-he-abolished [ve-hishbit] the-idolatrous-priests [ha-kemarim] whom the-kings of-Yehudah had-appointed, who-burned-incense in-the-high-places in-the-cities of-Yehudah and-the-environs of-Yerushalayim, and-those-who-burned-incense to-the-Ba'al, to-the-sun [la-shemesh] and-to-the-moon [la-yareach] and-to-the-constellations [la-mazzalot] and-to-all the-host of-the-heavens.

**23:6** And-he-brought-out the-Asherah from-the-house of-YHWH, outside Yerushalayim, to the-Wadi Qidron [nachal Qidron], and-he-burned-it in-the-Wadi Qidron and-ground-it [vayyadaq] to-dust ['afar] and-threw [vayashlekh] its-dust upon the-graves [qivrey] of-the-sons of-the-people.

**23:7** And-he-broke-down [vayitots] the-houses of-the-cult-prostitutes [ha-qedeshim] which [were] in-the-house of-YHWH, where the-women were-weaving coverings [battim] for-the-Asherah.

**23:8** And-he-brought all the-priests from-the-cities of-Yehudah, and-he-defiled [vayetamme] the-high-places where the-priests had-burned-incense, from-Geva to-Be'ersheva. And-he-broke-down the-high-places of-the-gates [bamot ha-she'arim] which [were] at-the-entrance of-the-gate of-Yehoshua, governor of-the-city, which [was] on-a-man's-left at-the-gate of-the-city.

**23:9** However [akh], the-priests of-the-high-places did-not go-up to the-altar of-YHWH in-Yerushalayim, but they-ate unleavened-bread [matstsot] among their-brothers.

**23:10** And-he-defiled the-Tofet [ha-Tofet] which [was] in-the-Valley of-the-Son of-Hinnom [gey ven Hinnom], so-that-no man [le-vilti] would-make-pass his-son or-his-daughter through-the-fire to-Molekh.

**23:11** And-he-removed [vayashbet] the-horses which the-kings of-Yehudah had-given to-the-sun, at-the-entrance of-the-house of-YHWH, by the-chamber [lishkat] of-Netan-Melekh the-officer [ha-saris] which [was] in-the-colonnade [ba-parvarim]. And-the-chariots of-the-sun [markevot ha-shemesh] he-burned in-the-fire.

**23:12** And-the-altars which [were] on the-roof [ha-gag] of-the-upper-chamber of-Achaz, which the-kings of-Yehudah had-made, and-the-altars which Menasheh had-made in-the-two courts of-the-house of-YHWH, the-king broke-down [natas] and-ran [vayarats] from-there and-threw [ve-hishlikh] their-dust into the-Wadi Qidron.

**23:13** And-the-high-places which [were] before [al peney] Yerushalayim, which [were] to-the-right of-the-Mount of-Destruction [har ha-mashchit], which Shelomoh king of-Yisra'el had-built for-Ashtoret, abomination of-the-Tsidonians, and-for-Kemosh, abomination of-Mo'av, and-for-Milkom, abomination of-the-sons of-Ammon — the-king defiled.

**23:14** And-he-broke-in-pieces [ve-shibbar] the-pillars [ha-matstsevot] and-cut-down [vayikhrot] the-Asherim [ha-asherim] and-filled their-places with-the-bones of-men [atsmot adam].

**23:15** And-also [ve-gam] the-altar which [was] in-Beyt-El, the-high-place which Yarov'am son of-Nevat, who-caused-Yisra'el-to-sin, had-made — even that altar and-the-high-place he-broke-down [natash]. And-he-burned the-high-place, ground-it to-dust, and-burned the-Asherah.

**23:16** And-turned Yoshiyyahu and-saw the-tombs [ha-qevarim] which [were] there on-the-mountain, and-he-sent and-took the-bones from the-tombs and-burned [them] on the-altar and-defiled-it, according-to-the-word of-YHWH which the-man of-God had-proclaimed [qara'], who had-proclaimed these things.

**23:17** And-he-said: What [is] this marker [ha-tsiyyun] which I see? And-the-men of-the-city said to-him: [It is] the-tomb of-the-man of-God who came from-Yehudah and-proclaimed these things which you-have-done against the-altar of-Beyt-El.

**23:18** And-he-said: Leave-him-alone [hannichhu lo]; let-no man move [yanis] his-bones. And-they-spared [vayemalletu] his-bones, with the-bones of-the-prophet who came from-Shomron.

**23:19** And-also [ve-gam] all the-houses of-the-high-places which [were] in-the-cities of-Shomron, which the-kings of-Yisra'el had-made to-provoke-anger, Yoshiyyahu removed [hesir], and-he-did to-them according-to-all the-deeds which he-had-done in-Beyt-El.

**23:20** And-he-slaughtered [vayizbach] all the-priests of-the-high-places who [were] there upon the-altars, and-he-burned the-bones of-men upon-them. And-he-returned to-Yerushalayim.

**23:21** And-commanded the-king all the-people, saying: Keep [asu] a-Pesach [Passover] to-YHWH your-God, as-it-is-written [ka-katuv] in this book of-the-covenant.

**23:22** For there-had-not been-kept [lo na'asah] a-Pesach like-this from-the-days of-the-judges [ha-shofetim] who-judged Yisra'el, and-all the-days of-the-kings of-Yisra'el and-the-kings of-Yehudah.

**23:23** But in-the-eighteenth year of-the-king Yoshiyyahu, this Pesach was-kept to-YHWH in-Yerushalayim.

**23:24** And-also [ve-gam] the-mediums [ha-ovot] and-the-familiar-spirits [ha-yidde'onim] and-the-household-gods [ha-terafim] and-the-idols [ha-gillulim] and-all the-abominations [ha-shiqqustsim] which-were-seen in-the-land of-Yehudah and-in-Yerushalayim, Yoshiyyahu removed [bi'er], in-order-to-establish [le-ma'an haqim] the-words of-the-Torah which-were-written in-the-book which Chilqiyyahu the-priest had-found in-the-house of-YHWH.

**23:25** And-like-him there-was-not before-him a-king who-turned [shav] to YHWH with-all his-heart [be-khol levavo] and-with-all his-soul [u-ve-khol nafsho] and-with-all his-might [u-ve-khol me'odo], according-to-all the-Torah of-Mosheh. And-after-him none-arose [lo qam] like-him.

**23:26** Nevertheless [akh], YHWH did-not turn [lo shav] from the-burning of-his-great wrath [charon appo ha-gadol], with-which his-anger burned [charah] against Yehudah, on-account-of all the-provocations [ha-kha'asim] with-which Menasheh had-provoked-him.

**23:27** And-said YHWH: Also [gam] Yehudah I-will-remove [asir] from my-face [me-'al panay], as I-removed Yisra'el, and-I-will-reject [u-ma'asti] this city which I-chose, Yerushalayim, and-the-house of-which I-said: My-name shall-be there.

**23:28** And-the-rest of-the-acts of-Yoshiyyahu and-all which he-did, are-they-not written in-the-book of-the-chronicles of-the-kings of-Yehudah?

**23:29** In-his-days went-up Pharaoh Nekho [Par'oh Nekhoh], king of-Mitsrayim, against the-king of-Ashur to-the-river Perat [Euphrates]. And-went the-king Yoshiyyahu to-meet-him [liqra'to], and-he-killed-him [vayemitehu] at-Megiddo when-he-saw-him.

**23:30** And-his-servants carried-him [vayarkivuhu] dead [met] from-Megiddo and-brought-him to-Yerushalayim and-buried-him in-his-tomb. And-took the-people of-the-land Yeho'achaz son of-Yoshiyyahu and-anointed-him [vayimshechu] and-made-him-king in-place of-his-father.

**23:31** A-son of-twenty and-three years [was] Yeho'achaz when-he-became-king, and-three months he-reigned in-Yerushalayim. And-the-name of-his-mother [was] Chamutal daughter of-Yirmeyahu from-Livnah.

**23:32** And-he-did the-evil in-the-eyes of-YHWH, according-to-all which his-fathers had-done.

**23:33** And-bound-him [vaya'asrehu] Pharaoh Nekho at-Rivlah in-the-land of-Chamat, from-reigning [mi-melokh] in-Yerushalayim, and-he-placed a-tribute ['onesh] on the-land: one-hundred talents of-silver and-a-talent of-gold.

**23:34** And-made-king Pharaoh Nekho Elyaqim son of-Yoshiyyahu in-place of-Yoshiyyahu his-father, and-he-turned [vayyassev] his-name to-Yehoyaqim. And-Yeho'achaz he-took, and-he-came to-Mitsrayim and-died there.

**23:35** And-the-silver and-the-gold Yehoyaqim gave to-Pharaoh, but he-assessed [he'erikh] the-land to-give the-silver according-to-the-command of-Pharaoh. Each-one according-to-his-assessment [ke-'erko] he-exacted [nagas] the-silver and-the-gold from-the-people of-the-land, to-give to-Pharaoh Nekho.

**23:36** A-son of-twenty and-five years [was] Yehoyaqim when-he-became-king, and-eleven years he-reigned in-Yerushalayim. And-the-name of-his-mother [was] Zevudah daughter of-Pedayah from-Rumah.

**23:37** And-he-did the-evil in-the-eyes of-YHWH, according-to-all which his-fathers had-done.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — sefer ha-berit:** The document is now called "the book of the covenant" (*sefer ha-berit*), whereas in 22:8 it was "the book of the Torah" (*sefer ha-torah*). Both designations point to Deuteronomy, which presents itself as both Torah (instruction) and covenant (agreement between YHWH and Israel).

**v.10 — Tofet in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom:** *Tofet* may derive from a root meaning "hearth" or "place of burning." The Valley of Hinnom (*gey Hinnom*) becomes *Gehenna* in later tradition — the archetypal place of destruction.

**v.25 — "with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his might":** This is a direct quotation of the Shema (Deut 6:5). Josiah is the only king described as fulfilling the Shema completely. Yet the very next verse (v.26) declares it insufficient.

**v.29 — Pharaoh Neco and Megiddo:** Josiah intercepts Neco at Megiddo (609 BCE) as the Egyptian marches to support the dying Assyrian empire against Babylon. Josiah's death is narrated with brutal brevity. The Chronicler (2 Chr 35:20-24) expands the account considerably.

*— EMET*
